violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026

Chicken was observed held at 125 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot-holding unit was turned up and chicken was re-heated to above 165 DF at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The presence of cockroaches is not controlled as evidenced by dead cockroaches in basement. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with a licensed pest control company/technician to eliminate pest problem and is to continue to follow pest control recommendations. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The walk-in cooler was observed holding an ambient temperature of 46 DF and in poor repair. No TCS foods stored in walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The floor under the kitchen 3-bay sink is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Application was printed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026

Raw animal foods chicken were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods rice in the 3-door reach-in. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Chicken was observed held between 120-130 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Chicken was reheated to above 165 DF and hot-hold unit was turned up at the time of inspection. Establishment is to monitor hot-holding temperatures, and ensure that all hot food stays above 135 DF or higher. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Beef, beans, eggs, yogurt, chicken, and salami were observed held between 55-60 degrees Fahrenheit in the walk-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All TCS food in walk-in cooler was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in walk-in cooler until it is able to hold ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Various food was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Establishment is to label all spray bottles. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Beans were placed hot on the counter in plastic containers greater than four inches deep. Beans were placed onto sheet pans at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The presence of cockroaches is not controlled as evidenced by dead cockroaches and live activity in basement. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with a licensed pest control company/technician to eliminate pest problem and is to have a detailed pest control report for the inspector at the time of next inspection. Establishment is to follow pest control recommendations. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The window screen, located in the seating area, was observed with a hole. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by being tight fitting. Establishment is to replace window screen. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

Food was observed being stored in plastic shopping bags, and non-food grade barrels/containers. Establishment is to store all food in food grade containers. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The hot holding unit sliding door was observed in poor repair. Establishment is to fix/replace sliding door. The walk-in cooler was observed holding an ambient of 57 DF and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of all refrigeration units/shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026
The floor under the kitchen 3-bay sink is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC has enrolled in course and will register with RIDOH CFP once completed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2024

Cooked onions were observed held at 97 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff took to reheat to 165 degrees during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety licensed with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2024

Raw animal foods (raw shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (prepared vegetables) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2024

Cut tomatoes and lettuce were observed held at 78- and 80- degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Containers of beans, pork, and meatballs were observed cooling on the counter in plastic containers more than 4 inches deep. Foods were relocated to refrigerator for active cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2024

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by roach carcasses and feces. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024
The open window and door in the kitchen do not have screens or other covering to prevent the entrance of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024
Single use containers are being reused to store foods. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024
The following were not in good repair: -door to walk-in observed with hole and exposed insulation -gaskets to 3-door reach-in. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

The condensate from the walk-in and the 3-door reach-in refrigeration units are draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other non-sewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024
Inspector observed a hole in the floor/wall juncture under the 3-bay sink in the basement. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement and outdoor seating area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2024
